'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Mike Richards LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Deck name:''' I hate Kyle Krueger
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
